name: Galápagos giant tortoise
desc: A huge herbivore that eats cactus, grasses, leaves and lichens and gets much of its water from Opuntia and dew. Long-lived adults have no natural predators.
about: The Galápagos tortoise, also called the Galápagos giant tortoise, is a very large species of tortoise in the genus Chelonoidis (which also contains three smaller species from mainland South America).
